summary: Measured the pinned main baseline against the original production source 9dc95184896118c96f34493da28ce40bf5b3d8d6 using the same cold Ready ReadFile fixture. Baseline result: 104 Git process starts, 6 remote fetches, 633 ms (existing file) and 551 ms (missing-file negative control). Implementation commit 53e311f2d: 75 Git process starts, 3 remote fetches, 420 ms and 366 ms respectively; warm Working reads were 0 Git processes/0 fetches in both. This is 29 fewer process starts, 3 fewer remote fetches and about one-third lower measured latency. The earlier 82/4 comment was inaccurate for the pinned baseline and is corrected to 104/6. Added an explicit GetAgentInstructions cold/warm measurement to cover the instruction-preparation branch in requestSnapshotCanSupplyGuidance.
